Circle **color** shows arrests per 1,000 estimated undocumented immigrants (Pew 2023 estimates). Click any circle for details; the popup links to the state's detailed page. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} us_states_sf <- sf::st_as_sf( maps::map("state", fill = TRUE, plot = FALSE) ) |> rename(state_lower = ID) sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Spherical geometry (s2) switched off ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cent_sf <- sf::st_centroid(us_states_sf) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: st_centroid assumes attributes are constant over geometries ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning in st_centroid.sfc(st_geometry(x), of_largest_polygon = of_largest_polygon): st_centroid does not give correct centroids for longitude/latitude data ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cent_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(cent_sf) centroids <- cent_sf |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> mutate(lon = cent_coords[, 1], lat = cent_coords[, 2]) sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Spherical geometry (s2) switched on ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} bubble_data <- centroids |> left_join(nw, by = "state_lower") |> filter(!is.na(n_arrests), n_arrests > 0) |> mutate( state_abbr = unname(STATE_ABBREVS[str_to_upper(state_lower)]), popup = paste0( "", state_title, "", if_else(!is.na(state_abbr), paste0(" details →"), ""), "
", "Post-inauguration arrests: ", format(n_arrests, big.mark = ","), "
", if_else(!is.na(arrests_per_1k_undoc), paste0("Arrests / 1,000 undocumented: ", arrests_per_1k_undoc, "
"), ""), if_else(!is.na(undoc_pop), paste0("Est. undocumented pop. (Pew 2023): ", format(undoc_pop, big.mark = ","), " (", round(undoc_pct_pop * 100, 1), "% of state)
"), ""), if_else(!is.na(pop_2025), paste0("State population (Census 2025): ", format(round(pop_2025), big.mark = ","), "
"), ""), if_else(!is.na(arrests_per_100k_pop), paste0("Arrests / 100k total population: ", arrests_per_100k_pop), "") ) ) pal_bubble <- colorNumeric( palette = c("#fff5f0", "#fc8d59", "#a50f15"), domain = bubble_data$arrests_per_1k_undoc, na.color = "#bbbbbb" ) rad_state <- function(n) pmax(5, log10(n + 1) * 10) leaflet(bubble_data) |> addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |> addCircleMarkers( lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = ~rad_state(n_arrests), fillColor = ~pal_bubble(arrests_per_1k_undoc), fillOpacity = 0.75, color = "#444", weight = 0.7, popup = ~popup, label = ~paste0(state_title, ": ", format(n_arrests, big.mark=","), " arrests; ", arrests_per_1k_undoc, "/1k undoc.") ) |> addLegend(pal = pal_bubble, values = ~arrests_per_1k_undoc, title = "Arrests per
1,000 undoc.", position = "bottomright") |> setView(lng = -96, lat = 38, zoom = 4) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

(Pew)", format = colFormat(separators = TRUE)) ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: --- ## Data notes - Source: [Deportation Data Project](https://deportationdata.org), FOIA 2026-ICLI-00005. Data through March 2026. - Arrests filtered to `apprehension_date ≥ 2025-01-20`. Duplicate-flagged rows excluded. - **Ratio** = arrests per day after inauguration ÷ arrests per day before. Before period: Oct 2022–Jan 19, 2025 (841 days). After period: Jan 20, 2025–Mar 31, 2026 (436 days). States with fewer than 5 pre-inauguration arrests excluded. - **Census population** from U.S. Census Bureau NST-EST2025-POP (July 1, 2025 estimates). - **Undocumented population** from Pew Research Center 2023 state estimates (released 2025). - Removal outcomes (% Removed / Released / Pending) from the stays dataset, for stays beginning on or after 2025-01-20. "Pending" = stay still open as of March 2026.
